data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Long ship times and bad customer service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/642de41a13b71428eda103f3)
I placed a $1500 order at the beginning of March and the mailed items took 3 weeks to come in. The rug I waited the longest for (over a month- and not on backorder) was not even the correct rug and I had to wait days for a response from customer service. 

Two of the items from that order ended up being "not in stock" after the order was placed. 

I'll never order from this company again. It seems like they're trying to get people to write good reviews to counterbalance all the negative ones.

April 4, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 6, 2023

Hi Kristy,

Thank you for reaching out; we're sorry to hear about your order. This is not the experience we wish for any of our customers. One of our representatives is actively working on your inquiry and will provide further updates when they can. If you have any further questions or concerns, don't hesitate to get in touch with support@luluandgeorgia.com.
